notes.title: This game is being removed
notes.notes:
We no longer support the development of this title and the servers are no longer active. Also, due to the lack of interest, activity and support, we are removing this title from the Steam store. For those who did show support for this game we thank you. 

We will be focusing on other titles of interest as we can only devote our time and resources on the games that players want to play. Unfortunately, inactive games are simply used to farm cards and for collection purposes. We are a company that take pride in our games and community of players so we are focusing on encouraging only the titles that players see value in actually playing. 

I do thank you all for your support over the years.

notes.title: Welcome to 2017... a word from the developer
notes.notes:
2 more of our games have been greenlit thanks to the support of the steam community. As lead developer for all of our games, I would like to extend a sincere thank you to the steam community as a whole for showing your support for our games once again. We owe you all everything as we are a very small team of only 2 people and rely greatly on the support of every player.

We aren't perfect but we are a dedicated and hard working team that has learned a lot since we've gotten our first game on steam. We are working harder than ever to meet your expectations and hope we can continue to make the games you all want to play. We appreciate your support and patience with us as we make strides to bring you the best games at an affordable price. 

We are looking forward to a great year. Making games is what we love to do, and making the games that you want to play is the only reason why we are still doing this. Your support means the world to us, not to sound sentimental but, you are all the reason why we do what we do.

I want to wish all of you a Happy, a Blessed and Prosperous 2017.

Happy New Year!

notes.title: 3rd Party Steam Key Time Limit Removed
notes.notes:
After speaking with some players very unpleased about the time limit for 3rd party bundled steam keys, we decided to remove the time limit after all. You all deserve better and I appreciate your support and words of encouragement. You could have gotten angry with us (deservingly) but you kept your cool, contacted us and gave your opinions. notes.title: AoF World Online: Community Edition is Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
Great news, we are making great progress with the community edition which will include all of the features and opportunities below. Remember, the community edition and all of it's features and bonuses will be open to everyone who currently owns a copy of AoF World Online and for everyone who purchases this version in the future. 

The Community Edition Will Include:

1. Server Application with Scripts - All players will have the opportunity to play the game locally on their computer independently using the server application. All players can edit the scripts as they see fit and make custom mods to how the game plays like unlimited drops, invincibility etc (these features will be reserved when you play locally on your computer. Modifying scripts will not change the games you play online on our servers). 

*The server and scripts are for single player use. You will NOT be able to host the server for other players to play on. That option is reserved for the Partner Server DLC.

2. Workshop - The workshop will be open and made available for all players to submit modified scripts with their own story versions, language translations, custom mods to the battle system, quests etc. There will also be an option for players to sell their mods or buy mods from other players. We will even include tutorials for the scripting which is very simple to learn and modify.

3. Fasaria World Online free access key - ALL players will get a free access key to create an account and play Fasaria World Online at no addition cost. This offer will become a regular part of the Community Edition and will require no addition fee, requirements to meet or any extra process to earn.  This is a $9.99 value and we will supply one key to be redeemed per account, per game. All you have to do is view your cd key from your game, access Fasaria World Online and register using your free access key. Learn more about the game below:

http://store.steampowered.com/app/398970

4. Art & Media Contests and  Workshop Submissions - We will be organizing contests for Art & Media. Almost anything can be submitted for the game. This will include UI design, story video, menus etc. All content can also be uploaded to the workshop for players to download for free or sale.

5. New Partner Servers Added to Play On - As we get more partners, we'll be adding them to our official server list that  players can choose to play on. Some partner servers will include modified scripts, story, quests etc. Each partner will have their server description and info posted on steam for players to view

6. News and Updates - We will be announcing new user submitted mods and scripts in our news. Every time something new is submitted, we'll make an announcement.

7. We are working hard to add more value to this game and community in spite of some of the challenges we've met along the way. We'll continue to find better ways of improving opportunities for our player base and community.

notes.title: Private Servers Approved
notes.notes:
We have decided to open private server hosting to players who own the server and scripts dlc in their inventory. *Note: You must own the dlc in your inventory in order to be able to host and apply.

How hosting will work:

Players who own a copy of the server and scripts dlc can apply to have their ip (must be a static ip) submitted  to us to be added to the list of available servers that players will have access to play on when we release our trial version (expected to be released late February 2016). Your server will be listed in our trial/demo dlc so all players who download the trial will have access to play on available private servers for free. All private server owners will have access to edit their scripts, sell resources or tokens if they like. The most active servers will have a chance to be added to our official/partner server list where paid players play.

Creating a server is very easy. All you need is a static ip, windows pc and broadband connection to get started. We supply simple instructions on how to get your server up and running. If you do not have a static ip, you can still host your game with us but you will need to have your ip updated in the chance that it changes or is changed. If your ip proves inconsistent, it may be removed from our list. We'll include simple details on how to get your ip set up.

If you own our server dlc and would like to host your own private server and get listed in our trial/demo list of servers, post here in this thread. When our opportunity is ready, we'll update the server dlc with instructions on how to get started. All you'll have to do is have the dlc, we'll reach out to you to get your ip set up with us.

Follow the link below to apply:

http://steamcommunity.com/app/339860/discussions/0/451850020338244119/

notes.title: NSE Circuit: December Newsletter
notes.notes:
You can find our full newsletter at NSE Circuit.

http://nsecircuit.com/news/dec15newsletter/

We have a lot of great news to announce for December! First off we would like to wish everyone a Merry Christmas, Happy Holidays and a Happy New Year! We are looking forward to a new a productive year in 2016. Looking back, we've gotten all 4 games greenlit and published on steam in less than 1 year! That is amazing and could only have been accomplished with your continued support. We are going to continue to work hard to meet your demands and your expectations of us, and we are incredibly thrilled and appreciative of your continued support for our games.
 
New NSE Circuit Launcher:
 
We've updated our launcher for Fasaria World Online and AoF Chess Club with a new one that should correct a lot of issues players encountered before, it is also updated with a snazzy look and feel so enjoy and post your input and opinions on the changes.
 
New Website & Shop:
 
We've updated our website with a new design and our community has been updated with better functions and community features for easier navigation. We will also be having monthly give aways and discount coupons exclusive to registered members so look out for those as well.
 
Trial Access & Demos:
 
We will be announcing our trial and demo access for each game in 2016. This should be an interesting way to allow players to experience our games and community while also inviting friends and other players to do the same. More info about our upcoming demos soon.
 
AoF World Online Private Servers:
 
We are considering providing an opportunity for players to host their own private servers while also being able to build their following of players from our community. All players who download the trial version will only have access to play on the private servers but for free. This will make it easy for those who own the private servers to invite players while getting new ones right from our community. If we do decide to do this, we will also offer community opportunities to help private server owners to build their network as well. We will also open up our workshop on steam where developers can modify the server scripts and share it or sell to other players. If this is an idea you support, please vote by posting in our discussion board thread below "I support this idea".
 
http://nsecircuit.com/index.php?page=forum&section=topic&top_id=100218
 
Fasaria World Online New Update:
 
We are working hard on a new expanded version of the game (no cost to current players) that will offer more levels, areas, gear to buy and a lot of other cool features. We have a lot planned for 2016 for updates and community growth. Look for the expanded version later this month.
 
Angels of Fasaria 2.0 Online Game and Future:
 
We are still working on the outline and plans for the online game which will require more time, planning and community building. We want to be sure this game does well when we put it forth in 2017. We are still looking for players who own the game to volunteer for alpha testing which we plan should start early next year. We will be heavily involved with the community and their input for the online game's development. So far we have Angels of Fasaria in the works for a re-make for the RPG and the online game is looking like it will be bundled with the game. Players who sign up and get active in testing will be guaranteed free copies of both. Those who  already have a copy of Angels of Fasaria 2.0 will only have an opportunity to claim a copy of the online game.
 
Please sign up for alpha testing in the thread below:
 
http://nsecircuit.com/index.php?page=forum&section=topic&top_id=100219
 
Showing Your Support for the Community:
 
We will be working hard from now on in building the community and it's involvement. We don't believe showing support is as simple as posting a review or by just receiving public approval as we have seen that such can never genuinely express the heart of it's community. The support will come only with your voice, your input, your ideas and your participation within the community. Such are vital to us as a company and to the future of the community you've helped to build. If you support our company and want to see more come out of our games, join the community on NSE Circuit and contribute your thoughts and ideas and encourage others to do the same. We will be working very closely with our players from now on to build a reliable, cohesive, friendly and active community. With every newsletter from now on, we will open a discussion for your thoughts starting now. Please post your thoughts, opinions, suggestions or ideas concerning this last newsletter in this thread.
 
http://nsecircuit.com/index.php?page=forum&section=topic&top_id=100220

notes.title: Sorry for the lack of involvement
notes.notes:
We've been very busy with our other games and it seems as if this game and community was ignored and has suffered quite a bit due to what some may consider a bit of "neglect". I take full responsibility and I'm very sorry to those who have shown support for this game and who have been hopeful for the community. 

I just took some time to read reviews, feedback and suggestions that I must admit, some of it is somewhat surprising and unexpected. After our last game bundle for this game we've been contacted privately with concerns for this game's future, with suggestions and hopeful optimism, some negative out lash but all around it shows that players still care about this game and it's future.

We assumed there was a lack of interest for this title is why we haven't given it a lot of our attention (not a good excuse) and opened it up for bundles to give more players an opportunity to have access to experience the game if they wanted. Bundles are great in many ways and the support from some bundles are amazing but in other ways, it can have it's draw backs as well.

It is our responsibility to make sure your support is recognized, appreciated and that we see to the needs of all of our players especially those who silently have continued to have expectations in our progress and development.

We have a very productive plan in the works for the community in general that we believe everyone will come to like so we ask that you continue to be patient with us. We are still working things out for our company structure for '16 but our all around plan should keep us actively involved with AoF World Online. We have not abandoned nor will we abandon this game contrary to some belief.

We will be giving more time to building the support base for this community while working hard on continued improvements on the game itself. AoF World Online uses a discontinued game engine that is no longer supported so our modifications and updates will always be with the general structure of the game's original design (no major over haul). 

We would like to open discussions now for community suggestions and feedback on what we could do better for the game and community. This is the first open forum I've invited for this game in quite some time so I do ask that everyone feel free to engage in the discussions and be open to give suggestions (keep in mind forum rules, no flaming, trolling or bating will be allowed). 

We don't really ask for any further support or contribution than what has already been given us. We just would like your feedback so we can know what else we can implement to make you all who have already shown support happier players/customers.

Post in the open discussion thread here: http://steamcommunity.com/app/339860/discussions/0/487876568228102677/

notes.title: Game Updates: Beginner's Bonus Experience and Extra Bonus Experience
notes.notes:
We made some updates to Ancients of Fasaria which includes "Beginner's Bonus Experience" and "Extra Bonus Experience".

All players will receive "Beginner's Bonus Experience" from levels 1-5 from now on. This is simply an added feature we believe would be helpful for early level players to get a head start in the game.

We also added  "Extra Bonus Experience" for defeating an enemy using the "Redemption" or "Damnation" skill. You can earn up to 3 times your normal experience this way. This adds more value to the skill and rewards players for using it.

notes.title: If Ancients of Fasaria isn't for you...
notes.notes:
ːaofdefː Ancients of Fasaria is an indie mmorpg supported by a small team of developers. We take to heart every comment and suggestion as our intent is to meet the needs of the players and those who have shown support for our games. All constructive criticism and advice is welcome as we are constantly working hard to do better for our players.

ːaofdefː If you have any concerns or gripes about our game, community, customer service or policies, please let us know in a constructive manner either in private or on the community board. We need to know how to do better for you.

[h1] ːstrongarmː If you purchased Ancients of Fasaria from steam and are displeased with your purchase in any way, please contact us directly from our website and let us know why you were not satisfied with our game and we will replace your purchase with any of our games now or in the future of equal or more value.[/h1]

ːkeybotː We are always looking for better ways of improving our games and community. If any of our games have not lived up to your expectations, let us know why so we can do better for you, or we can find a way to make it up to you. 

ːkeybotː We do understand that some players can not be appeased no matter how much we try. Our games may not be for everyone (as no game is) and we do try to accommodate every suggestion from our players. If you purchased any of our games and it did not live up to your expectations, we still appreciate your support. Your suggestions, contributions and input is valuable to us regardless if you decide to be an active part of our community.  

ːpowergloveː What we can NOT do is allow or support abusive or malicious behavior in anyway. This is not just to protect our community and our company but it isn't fair to those who have or do show support for the game as it robs them of the opportunity to freely engage in the very thing that they do love. That behavior is unfair to the players and it is unsupported.

ːaofmedː We offer customer and free technical support for everyone who purchased the game. If you have any technical issues, feel free to post on steam discussion boards or contact us directly for immediate support and help.

[url=http://my.ancientsoffasaria.com/index.php?page=contact]Contact Us - Technical/Customer Support[/url]

ːkeybotː Please feel free to let us know how we can improve on our games and our service. Feel free to comment (observing forum rules). We work hard to make fast replies to all requests and suggestions.
